verdicts.reason: A real mechanism (randomization, power, false positives, early stopping) that readers want and bayes-theorem does not cover, though it partly shares its trial-arm framing with placebo-expectation and screening-overdiagnosis in this batch.
An amplifying enzyme cascade with published kinetics and drug or haemophilia knockouts is a clear mechanism at an honest level 3, and no existing page covers it.
The site has no hearing page; the place code (a travelling wave on a graded membrane) and the cochlear-implant finale make a strong, visual, distinct level-3 mechanism.

Countercurrent mass transfer and the urea sawtooth are a real mechanism, but the page leans on kidney-nephron and repeats its countercurrent idea, so it is better as a closing section of that page than as a page of its own.
Computing the ECG from an excitable-medium model and breaking it into a spiral wave goes far past heart-circulation's synced trace, and it is a showcase mechanism at an honest level 3.
The pressure reversal at the first breath is a neat mechanism and distinct, but the subject is niche and it depends on haemoglobin-oxygen and partly reuses lung-gas-exchange from this batch.

How sample size makes a Manhattan plot rise out of the noise, false peaks from population structure and the limits of polygenic scores are a real level-3 mechanism with high public interest, and none of it duplicates meiosis-inheritance.
The cooperative binding curve and its shifts (Bohr effect, carbon monoxide) are a core mechanism, distinct from respiration-atp, and a needed prerequisite for lung-gas-exchange and fetal-circulation.

A Hopfield-style attractor network with pattern completion, interference and consolidation is a genuine level-3 model, and its recurrent completion is distinct from neural-networks' feed-forward training.
The bell-shaped crosslinking curve is a real but narrow mechanism; it shares its circulation-collapse ending with sepsis-inflammation, so one of the two is enough.

The countercurrent multiplier stepped cycle by cycle is a classic hard-to-picture mechanism that an animation explains well, it is absent from the site, and two other candidates in the batch depend on it.
Extraction ratio and first-pass metabolism are a real mechanism but a narrow extension of pharmacokinetics-dosing in this batch, and it would work better as a section of that page.

Ventilation-perfusion mismatch and shunt, computed through the real dissociation curves, are a strong, counterintuitive level-3 mechanism distinct from heart-circulation, though it sits close to haemoglobin-oxygen.
An oscillator emerging from feedback that flips sign, with the pill as the intervention, is a widely relevant mechanism, and it is distinct from homeostasis's steady-state loop.
medical-imaging only sketches MRI; the Bloch equations, the gradients and filling k-space make a distinct, visually striking level-3 page built on fourier-transform.

A small wired circuit that shows gating and sensitization is a real mechanism, but gate-control theory is a simplified, partly dated model and the page overlaps placebo-expectation's descending modulation.
Accumulation to steady state over four to five half-lives is a widely useful mechanism that needs only exponentials, so it reads more honestly at level 2, and it should absorb liver-drug-metabolism.
The Bayesian cue-combination model is normative rather than a mechanism, and its trial-arm half (regression to the mean, natural recovery) duplicates clinical-trials in this batch.
Lead-time and length bias are a counterintuitive mechanism that a cohort simulation shows well and that bayes-theorem does not cover, and they need no university-level model, so level 2 is honest.
The four-variable acute-inflammation model, with its distinct outcomes and the response itself as the disease, is a real level-3 dynamical mechanism distinct from immune-system.
The two-threshold selection trade-off is a clean mechanism distinct from immune-system's clonal expansion, but the model is thin and close to a single plotted histogram.

A travelling-wave reaction-diffusion model is a genuine level-3 mechanism, but the infection and diabetes effects are only stated rate cuts, and the subject draws weaker demand than the other medicine candidates.
The weather-versus-climate distinction is a valuable level-0 idea built on real data, but the page shows a pattern rather than a mechanism and is closer to a data explorer than a how-it-works page.
A familiar beach, one control (the slope of the sea floor), the bobbing duck and waves breaking in the shallows make an ideal level-0 mechanism that leads naturally into waves-interference.
Following one rising bubble of air explains flat cloud bottoms, cold mountains and the rain shadow with no formulas, an excellent level-0 mechanism distinct from atmosphere-weather's global view.
A real university mechanism (Nernst/GHK, pump, osmotic volume) that neurons takes for granted, so it is distinct and well suited to a live voltage graphic.
An honest level-3 systems-biology model (FBA by linear programming) with visible flux rerouting, but it is niche for this site's visitors and heavy to build in the browser.
Generalised Lotka-Volterra with inferred interactions and alternative stable states is a real level-3 mechanism distinct from the ecosystems page, though a ten-group matrix is hard to make legible.
Stochastic stepping, stall force and force-velocity curves are a vivid mechanism the graphic can show, clearly distinct from the ATP synthase rotor in respiration-atp.

Covers the reserve item on pattern formation with a real diffusion-decay model and the French flag; it is distinct, but it should be planned together with turing-patterns and segmentation-clock so the three do not blur.
Computing trees from sequences (UPGMA versus neighbour joining, clock violations) is a genuine algorithmic mechanism that is distinct from deep-time and evolution.
Wright-Fisher drift versus selection, with Kimura's fixation probability, is the core university model the evolution page lacks, and it is ideal for many live traces.
Eigen's error threshold is a real mechanism with a clear takeaway, but it is niche, overlaps population-genetics in machinery, and lists a level-3 candidate as a prerequisite.
Diffusion plus LuxI/LuxR positive feedback giving a collective threshold switch is a showable mechanism distinct from crispr and lac-operon, and appealing as glowing bacteria.
The Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry model is the real level-3 leaf model, and its C3/C4/CAM comparison goes well beyond the level-1 photosynthesis page.
The clock-and-wavefront model is a distinct, elegant mechanism, but it is a third pattern-formation page beside morphogen-gradients and turing-patterns and leans on a level-3 prerequisite.
Huang-Ferrell MAPK ultrasensitivity is a real model with a striking dose-response result, and it is distinct from the hormone-level homeostasis page.
Dobzhansky-Muller incompatibilities snowballing is a genuine mechanism, but it builds on population-genetics, a level-3 candidate, and its graphic is more abstract than its siblings'.
The STDP window and unsupervised pattern pick-up are a real local learning rule, clearly distinct from gradient-descent training in neural-networks and from spike generation in neurons.
Reaction-diffusion spots and stripes are a beautiful, widely sought mechanism driven by a real PDE, and they are distinct from chaos-fractals.
The Perelson within-host model with biphasic decay and resistance under combination therapy is real level-3 material, distinct from population-level epidemics.
A familiar subject with a clear flag-and-guard mechanism and a chart the reader fills in, needing no formulas: an ideal level-0 toy.
An everyday experience with a clear heat-budget feedback that a 10-year-old can drive with one control; it shares the feedback idea with homeostasis but uses a different variable and a concrete body.
The diaphragm-and-bell-jar pressure mechanism is a classic KS2/KS3 'how it works' subject with an immediate toy, and it is distinct from heart-circulation.
A core primary curriculum topic with a staged mechanism (where each juice acts, absorption in the small intestine), distinct from homeostasis's blood-glucose view.
The raised set point is a good insight, but it is the same thermostat model and graphic as the body-thermostat candidate and should be one step of that page rather than a page of its own.
Hand-to-surface transmission chains with counts and one washing control make a clear level-0 mechanism, distinct from the crowd SIR model in epidemics.
Scrubbing growth-chart data shows what happens but no mechanism (no growth plates, no hormones), so it is a data survey rather than a how-it-works page.
Promotes the reserve cochlea item as a clear place-by-pitch mechanism with one slider, distinct from waves-interference's wave in the air.
Counting your own pulse is a lovely hands-on start, but the mechanism is thin and partly covered by heart-circulation's rate control, so it would be stronger folded into a level-0 heart page.
A pump-leak ODE (ion fluxes by GHK, Na/K pump, osmotic volume) is a few coupled equations that run instantly, and the Nernst and GHK values are exact checks; no data needed.

Flux balance analysis on a core network of around 100 reactions is a small LP that a JS simplex solves in milliseconds, but the network must be built from textbook stoichiometry with citations because BiGG e_coli_core is not openly licensed.
A ten-species generalized Lotka-Volterra ODE with an antibiotic term is tiny, and Stein et al. 2013 publish the fitted matrix in PLOS Computational Biology under CC BY.
A Gillespie simulation of a discrete-state kinesin model with Fisher-Kolomeisky rates gives the staircase traces and force-velocity curves cheaply, with the parameters taken from the published paper.
A 1D diffusion-decay PDE with thresholds is a small honest model with an analytic steady state to check against; the scaling mechanism needs one stated extra term.

UPGMA, neighbour joining and parsimony scoring on a dozen short shipped GenBank sequences are trivial in the browser, and GenBank data has no reuse restrictions; letting the reader drag branches is the only fiddly UI part.
A hundred Wright-Fisher binomial traces per generation are cheap, and fixation near 2s and the Hardy-Weinberg ratios are exact checks; no data needed.

A population of bit strings copied with errors on a single-peak landscape runs fast and shows the error threshold honestly; the replicase-evolution, parasite and compartment chapters add scope and should be kept lean.
Cells on a grid secreting a diffusing, decaying signal with a Hill-type LuxR switch make a small reaction-diffusion and agent model that shows the collective switch directly.

The Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry model is closed-form with published Bernacchi temperature parameters, and von Caemmerer's C4 model is also analytic; CAM over a day needs a simpler stated stomatal schedule.
A strip of Lewis delay-differential oscillators with Notch coupling and a moving wavefront is a small DDE system that runs interactively with a history buffer; no data needed.
The Huang-Ferrell MAPK ODEs (BIOMD0000000009, CC0) are a few dozen mass-action equations, and the dose-response steepening is directly computable.

An explicit two-population, multi-locus simulation with random pairwise Dobzhansky-Muller incompatibilities is cheap and makes the snowball emerge rather than be drawn; migration and reinforcement are extra parameters on the same model.

Pair-based exponential STDP and a leaky integrate-and-fire neuron with twenty inputs (Song-Miller-Abbott) run easily in real time; the hidden-pattern demo needs careful tuning so that it emerges reliably.
A Gierer-Meinhardt or Gray-Scott grid PDE runs at interactive rates in JS (or WebGL) and shows the diffusion-ratio threshold honestly; growing and tapered domains are a mask on the same grid.
The Perelson target-cell ODE with drug efficacy and a resistant strain is a handful of equations whose biphasic decay slopes give the stated half-lives.

The honest model is antigen-versus-antibody set logic, which is real but thin; it rises above a tap-and-reveal chart only if the clumping is simulated (cells cross-linked by antibodies) and the eight-by-eight chart is computed from the rule rather than drawn.
A one-node heat-balance ODE with a proportional controller for skin blood flow, shivering and capped sweating is small and honest at level 0, and it overheats when evaporation saturates.

Boyle's law with airflow driven by the pressure difference, plus a CO2 accumulator for breath-holding, is a small real model, but the risk is an animated cutaway in which the model does little; the CO2 drive should be the model's output, not a scripted bar.

A compartment model with first-order breakdown and absorption is buildable, but the rates are rough textbook figures and the page leans toward a scripted scrub-through of a diagram; it needs the food-dependent emptying and breakdown to come from the model.
It reuses the body-thermostat heat-balance model with a movable set point, so it is cheap and honest; it may work better as a chapter of body-thermostat than as its own page.

An agent model of touches transferring fractions between hands and surfaces, with decay on surfaces, is small; transfer efficiencies come from published fomite studies (Rusin et al. 2002) as stated parameters, with no dataset to license.

Scrubbing the CDC stature-for-age LMS percentile files (US government, public domain) and differencing them for growth velocity is an honest small-dataset page, though the model is a data lookup rather than a mechanism.

The Greenwood place function with a bank of passive resonators along the basilar membrane, driven by the tone, computes the bump positions honestly and runs easily; the ossicle lever is a stated gain.

Heart rate following effort with exponential recovery and a pulse-wave delay is a real but very thin model, and the pulse-counting stopwatch is a tool rather than a model; it risks reading as an animation with sliders.

A clear staged mechanism (haematoma, soft callus, hard callus, remodelling) with one honest control (cast vs movement) that a 10-year-old who has seen a cast will follow; distinct from bridges-structures and from the level-3 bone-remodelling candidate.

Platelet plug and scab under new skin is a real mechanism from an everyday experience and works at level 0, though the cut-depth and scab-picking controls make a thinner toy than its sibling healing candidates.

Stomach stretch and gastric emptying rates give a genuine, formula-free mechanism with a nice same-energy comparison, distinct from homeostasis's blood-sugar loop, though the satiety story is simplified (hormones are left out) and the page must not overclaim.
A build toy where joint shape limits reach is honest at level 0 and distinct from bridges-structures, but it leans towards a classification of joint types more than a single causal mechanism.
Antagonistic pairs plus the elbow lever (the biceps pulls many times the load) is a vivid mechanism readable with counts and comparisons only, and nothing existing shows it.

The spinal shortcut against the brain route, with the reader's own reaction test, is a strong level-0 toy distinct from neurons' ion-channel spike; it substantially duplicates the batch's reflex-arc-reaction-time, so only one of the two should go in, and this is the better fit for the level-0 push.
The combinatorial receptor-pattern code and the pinched-nose test show a real mechanism a child can play with, a good level-0 sibling to vision-color without repeating it.
The Stephan-curve timeline (how often beats how much) makes a counterintuitive, everyday takeaway from one schedulable control; honest at level 0 and distinct from acids-bases.
Counting rays through the lotion (1/SPF) and showing that a thin layer matters more than the number is a real mechanism with counts only, high everyday demand, and no overlap with light-optics.

The resting-versus-exercise energy budget is a useful counterintuitive takeaway and honest at level 0, but it is closer to an accounting display than a mechanism the graphic can show, and must avoid diet-advice framing.

Haemoglobin breakdown through green and yellow is a real sequence a child has seen on their own skin, but the toy is mostly a colour timeline with one control, and it sits near how-cuts-heal in theme.

A head-start race of counts is an honest level-0 framing, but its takeaway (memory is already in place) is the same as mrna-vaccines and immune-system's second response, so it is a simpler retelling rather than a new mechanism.
Lagging fluid in the semicircular canals, and the reversed feeling on stopping, is a clean inertia mechanism every child has felt, and no existing page covers it.
The two-process model (a sleep-pressure tank plus a circadian window) is a real model that works as a level-0 toy with one bedtime control, high in everyday interest and distinct from homeostasis.
Filter-then-reclaim and the ADH water loop is core GCSE biology with a genuine mechanism, a natural level-1 sibling to homeostasis, and nothing existing covers it.
Its hot-plate reflex loop, spinal shortcut and reaction-time test substantially duplicate the batch's level-0 reflexes candidate, so the two should be merged into one page rather than both built.

Gompertz life tables, the mutation-accumulation argument and a reliability model that reproduces the straight log line make a real university-level model with a striking takeaway, distinct from evolution.

The three-compartment target-controlled infusion model with an effect site and context-sensitive wake-up is exactly what a pharmacology or anaesthesia student learns, and it has a surprising takeaway; it depends on the pool's pharmacokinetics-dosing being chosen.

PK curves crossed with the mutant selection window give a real model and a takeaway that corrects a common belief, going well beyond evolution's antibiotic example; it depends on pharmacokinetics-dosing.

A published glucose-insulin model under a tunable controller with sensor and absorption delays is a real level-3 control problem, building on homeostasis and feedback-control without repeating either.
A closed-loop baroreflex with standing, haemorrhage, Valsalva and set-point drift is a real physiology model, distinct from heart-circulation's open-loop pressure.

The Davenport diagram with lungs and kidneys on two clocks is genuine level-3 physiology and distinct from acids-bases, but it is a narrow clinical tool and depends on two pool candidates (lung-gas-exchange, kidney-nephron) as prerequisites.

Strain-driven remodelling that grows trabeculae (Wolff's law) is a real model with a striking emergent graphic, but a finite-element grid of thousands of elements is heavy to run as a pure function of time in the browser.
The Kuznetsov-style tumour-immune ODEs, with elimination, equilibrium and escape and a checkpoint 'brake' to release, are a real model that extends cancer and immune-system without duplicating them.

Visuomotor rotation, with the reader's own hand fitted by the two-rate error-driven model and showing aftereffects and savings, is a real research model and an unforgettable interactive with no overlap.

An everyday object with a hidden mechanism (hyphae spreading ahead of the visible spot) that a one-control x-ray toy shows well; no fungus appears anywhere in the catalogue, and the 'cut it off' payoff works for a 10-year-old.
A familiar experience explained by one clear mechanism (cutting a cell mixes two separated ingredients), with honest single-variable remedies, at level 0, and distinct from the-cell.
A kitchen trick with a real gas-feedback mechanism that the particles and the bag/bowl/fridge controls show directly; honest at level 0, and no page covers fruit or ethylene.

A classic primary-school experiment with a surprising, showable takeaway (sprouts in the dark, mass falls before leaves open); clearly the stage before photosynthesis, so it doesn't overlap that page.
Real ring-width data and the crossdating slide give a real mechanism and method, not just a fact, and it works without formulas; distinct from deep-time's whole-Earth timeline.
